text:
maria: Heads up — PR gating kept failing overnight. Looks like GH Actions scheduled workflow started overlapping PR runs and exhausted the self-hosted runner pool. Repro notes below.

maria: ```yaml
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *' # nightly
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'evals/**'
jobs:
  run-evals:
    concurrency: 'evals-${{ github.ref }}'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux]
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/run-full-eval.sh
```

sam: :eyes: I saw the same. The flaky failures always coincided with the start of the nightly at 02:00 UTC. Self-hosted autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough, so PR workflows queued and then timed out.

lee: We're also hitting long quantization matrix jobs that hog nodes for 45-90m. Because the path filter includes evals/** several PRs end up running the full matrix unnecessarily.

devops: Short-term mitigation: add a PR-only lightweight workflow (eval-smoke-pr) that runs a tiny smoke set (5-10 short prompts) and returns status fast. Longer-term: stagger nightly cron windows and route heavy runs to buildkite/dedicated nodes. :thumbsup:

maria: Proposed PR-only GHA snippet:```yaml
name: eval-smoke-pr
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux]
    concurrency:
      group: smoke-${{ github.sha }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/run-smoke-eval.sh --limit 10 --timeout 300
```

oliver: Also add a very small timeout and make sure the smoke script uses cached artifacts (model weights) where possible. That will keep run time <5min in most cases.

rachel: For heavy nightly runs we should dispatch to buildkite with a GitHub Actions "workflow_dispatch" to avoid stealing our self-hosted GHA runners. Buildkite has longer queues but separate pools.

ci-bot: buildkite connector note: triggers support passing commit sha and artifact manifest, but we need to standardize artifact paths so BK jobs can pick up prebuilt quantized binaries.

devops: Action items I can take: 1) Add eval-smoke-pr workflow with concurrency cancel-in-progress. 2) Add paths filter to prevent full matrix on docs/ or infra/ changes. 3) Stagger nightly cron into three windows (02:00, 02:07, 02:14 UTC) with small jitter. 4) Add PR label "run-full-eval" to opt-in.

lee: Also propose a new gating reporter job that checks a small set of production-quality metrics (ROUGE, perplexity, latency) and exposes 3-state status: pass / warn / fail. Fail rules could be: rouge_delta < -0.02 OR perplexity > +5% OR latency regression > +10%. Warn otherwise.

maria: Agree. We should fail PRs only on robust regressions. Add a flaky-tolerance window: if a metric regresses on one shard but not majority, post a warning and track on dashboard, don't block.

oliver: Implementation note: the smoke reporter can emit a JSON artifact with metrics. Example: `artifact.json` {"rouge": "0.243", "baseline_rouge": "0.265", "perplexity": "18.4"} — then reporter job computes deltas and posts a PR comment.

rachel: I'll prototype a warm-pool for GHA self-hosted runners for the 30m before and after the nightly windows so cold-starts aren't killing us.

devops: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/add-eval-smoke-pr. It adds the workflow + concurrency + path filters + label. Ping @maria @lee for review. :shipit:

maria: Quick extra item — add a debounce on webhook triggers so if multiple commits hit a branch in short succession we coalesce runs (thundering-herd). Could be a small service or use github actions `concurrency` with same group name. :facepalm:

lee: +1. Also, expose the flaky shard ids and last 5 pulls' metric history in the PR comment so owners can triage.

ci-bot: Automation note: once smoke passes we can trigger a full-eval dispatch with `workflow_dispatch` to buildkite if label present. This keeps GH runners light and moves heavy compute to dedicated capacity.

maria: Thanks everyone — let's get the smoke workflow in and the reporter thresholds defined. We'll run a two-week experiment and measure PR latency and blocker reduction.

sam: Sounds good. I'll monitor runner utilization and post numbers in #eng-infra tomorrow.

devops: Will follow up with the cron-stagger PR and the buildkite dispatch doc.

maria: Closing loop: if anyone sees new flakes after change, ping and we'll escalate to a rollback. :pray:
